articles.author: Crispus Nyaga
articles.headline: SK Hynix Stock Jumped After US IPO, But SpaceX, Figma, Circle Suggest Retreat Likely
articles.summary: SK Hynix stock soared after its recent US IPO, but recent IPOs, including the likes of SpaceX, Figma and Circle suggest a retreat is coming.
articles._summary: SK Hynix aims to use the windfall to boost its manufacturing operations in South Korea as it seeks to solidify its market share. Together with Samsung, the companies aim to invest over $500 billion in South Korea in the coming years. The company’s business is having the best year, helped by the rising demand for its memory products. This growth has pushed its revenue much higher, with the CEO predicting that the memory boom will last through 2030.
articles._zh_headline: SK 海力士美国 IPO 后股价大涨，但 SpaceX、Figma 和 Circle 暗示可能撤退
articles._zh_summary: SK 海力士希望利用这笔意外之财来促进其在韩国的制造业务，以巩固其市场份额。两家公司计划与三星一起，在未来几年内在韩国投资超过 5000 亿美元。得益于内存产品需求的不断增长，该公司的业务迎来了最好的一年。这种增长大大推动了其收入的增长，首席执行官预测内存繁荣将持续到 2030 年。

articles.author: Crispus Nyaga
articles.headline: Musk’s Net Worth Down $407 Billion From Trillion-Plus High as SpaceX Stock Dives
articles.summary: SpaceX stock price has dived to a record low this year, with Elon Musk's net worth plunging by $407 billion in the last few weeks.
articles._summary: According to Bloomberg data, Elon Musk’s net worth has dropped to $913 billion, a decline of more than $407 billion from its record high of $1.32 trillion. He is still the richest person on earth, with his wealth being bigger than that of three other billionaires – Larry Page , Sergey Brin , and Jeff Bezos – combined. The ongoing retreat is mostly because of SpaceX, whose stock has remained in free fall.
articles._zh_headline: 随着 SpaceX 股价暴跌，马斯克的净资产从万亿美元高位下跌 4070 亿美元
articles._zh_summary: 据彭博社数据，埃隆·马斯克的净资产已跌至 9130 亿美元，较历史高点 1.32 万亿美元减少逾 4070 亿美元。他仍然是地球上最富有的人，他的财富比其他三位亿万富翁——拉里·佩奇、谢尔盖·布林和杰夫·贝索斯——的总和还多。持续的下跌主要是因为 SpaceX，该公司的股价一直在直线下跌。

articles.author: Mohd Haider
articles.headline: Elon Musk Revives Feud With Sam Altman, Says He Took 'Scamming to a Whole New Level'
articles.summary: Elon Musk and Sam Altman reignited their feud over AI safety, space data centers and allegations of trade-secret theft.
articles._summary: Elon Musk and Sam Altman traded fiery accusations on X on Sunday, reigniting their long-running feud over AI safety, space data centers and alleged trade-secret theft. The comment echoed a post Musk made in April, when he called Altman “ Scam Altman” after a New Yorker investigation questioned Altman’s credibility on AI safety. In his X post, Musk also accused Altman of taking over an open-source AI charity and stealing Apple’s (NASDAQ: AAPL ) phone technology.
articles._zh_headline: 埃隆·马斯克 (Elon Musk) 与萨姆·奥尔特曼 (Sam Altman) 再度不和，称他将“诈骗提升到了一个全新的水平”
articles._zh_summary: 埃隆·马斯克 (Elon Musk) 和萨姆·奥尔特曼 (Sam Altman) 周日在 X 上相互指责，重新点燃了他们在人工智能安全、太空数据中心和涉嫌盗窃商业秘密方面的长期不和。这一评论与马斯克四月份发表的一篇文章相呼应，在《纽约客》的一项调查质疑奥特曼在人工智能安全方面的可信度后，马斯克称奥特曼为“骗子奥特曼”。在他的 X 帖子中，马斯克还指责 Altman 接管了一家开源人工智能慈善机构并窃取了苹果（纳斯达克股票代码：AAPL）的手机技术。

articles.author: Crispus Nyaga
articles.headline: Nvidia Stock is Finally Soaring, and Rare Chart Pattern Points to More Upside
articles.summary: Nvidia stock price is rising after moving to a technical bear market, and a rare falling wedge pattern points to a rebound.
articles._summary: Technicals suggest that Nvidia may be on the cusp of more upside in the coming weeks. It has been forming a falling wedge pattern in the past few months. A wedge pattern consists of two descending, converging trendlines. A bullish breakout typically occurs as the two trendlines approach their point of convergence. Nvidia has now rebounded above the upper line of the wedge. It also rebounded when it landed at the 200-day moving average.
articles._zh_headline: 英伟达股价终于飙升，罕见的图表模式表明还有更多上涨空间
articles._zh_summary: 技术面显示，英伟达可能在未来几周内处于进一步上涨的风口浪尖。在过去的几个月里，它一直在形成下降楔形形态。楔形形态由两条下降、汇聚的趋势线组成。当两条趋势线接近其交汇点时，通常会发生看涨突破。英伟达现已反弹至楔形上限上方。登陆200日均线后也出现反弹。

articles.author: Snigdha Gairola
articles.headline: Marc Andreessen Says AI Is 'Already a Better Doctor Than 99.99% of Human Doctors'
articles.summary: Andreessen reignites AI in healthcare debate by praising OpenAI's GPT-5.6 results. CEO Sam Altman claims AI is better than 99.99% of doctors.
articles._summary: Venture capitalist Marc Andreessen reignited the debate over artificial intelligence in healthcare after praising a new OpenAI finding suggesting physicians identified fewer flaws in GPT-5.6’s medical responses than in responses written by doctors. On Saturday, Andreessen posted on X while reposting OpenAI CEO Sam Altman’s comments about the company’s latest AI model. “AI is already a better doctor than 99.99% of human doctors. This is good news,” Andreessen wrote.
articles._zh_headline: Marc Andreessen 表示人工智能“已经比 99.99% 的人类医生更好”
articles._zh_summary: 风险投资家马克·安德森 (Marc Andreessen) 对 OpenAI 的一项新发现表示赞赏，该发现表明医生在 GPT-5.6 的医疗响应中发现的缺陷比医生撰写的响应中发现的缺陷更少，这再次引发了有关医疗保健领域人工智能的争论。周六，Andreessen 在 X 上发帖，同时转发了 OpenAI 首席执行官 Sam Altman 关于该公司最新人工智能模型的评论。 “人工智能已经是比 99.99% 的人类医生更好的医生了。这是个好消息，”安德森写道。
